claim_being_audited: The actor claims model-card certification can proceed on a disclose-and-certify basis because the model passes the aggregate threshold, the small-business support slice is an unresolved weakness that must be disclosed, and no approved mitigation currently removes deployment exposure.
specific_concerns: Only the actor's summary and evidence IDs are available; the underlying contents of BMCARD-036-A through BMCARD-036-E are not available for independent verification.
The actor makes quantitative claims about threshold margins and subgroup underperformance, but no admissible numeric record is provided to confirm them.

The policy standard turns on whether the slice weakness is material and disclosed, but the record provided to the auditor does not include the actual model-card disclosure text or materiality determination.
The claim that no approved mitigation removes deployment exposure depends on approval status evidence that is not directly available.
The recommended action is 'certify_model,' which may overstate support unless the required disclosure is actually present in the certification packet.
unsupported_claims: The model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is 1.1 percentage points below its warning threshold and 2.6 points below its preferred threshold.
No approved mitigation currently removes deployment exposure because the only mitigation in the record is a draft.
Sampling uncertainty justifies cautionary framing and a near-term recheck.
evidence_requests: Provide the contents of BMCARD-036-A through BMCARD-036-E, not just their IDs.
Provide the evaluation table showing aggregate and small-business support slice results, thresholds, sample sizes, and confidence intervals.
Provide the governing materiality/disclosure section of the model-card policy as applied to this case.
Provide the actual model-card or certification text showing the weakness is expressly disclosed.
Provide the mitigation record and approval status showing whether any approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty can reduce confidence, but it does not by itself justify treating an unresolved weakness as a clean certification.
Independent audit support requires admissible evidence for quantitative performance claims, mitigation status, and disclosure status.
